modelBoundary: One symbolic private-capable note, one reusable block ID, one worker, one API, one global body slot; thin queue length one, source/SQL revisions 1/2, block hash and epoch independently 1/2, embedding schema epoch 1/2 and captured/vector/retry schema tokens 0/1/2, two incremental chunks, one symbolic payload unit per batch. At most one source OR hash OR block-epoch OR embedding-schema update, one provider failure OR cancellation and one API operation. Source/schema replacement are separate configurations. SchemaReset is allowed during Provider or Complete (SQL pending before atomic mutation), without source revision changes. No cursor/audit variables: unchanged FM003 projection remains authority.

Provider eventually responds, SQL/source available, generations stabilize; cancellation models retained ownership through late reply then disposal, not unresponsive transport termination.

SQL locks/MVCC, actual SHA/OID computation, chunk text/embedding arithmetic, provider parsing, filesystem failures/power loss, multiworker scheduling, parser/driver/HTTP allocation and RSS are omitted.
